links.comparator_used: No direct comparison with the original unsimplified reports; pathologists rated the ChatGPT simplifications on their own
links.outcome: Pathologist-rated factual accuracy, completeness and potential harm of ChatGPT-simplified gynecologic cytopathology reports
links.effect: 180 evaluations by 6 pathologists; the vast majority were scored accurate, factually complete and not perceived as possibly harmful, especially with prompt 2. No numeric scores given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Ratings are pathologists' opinions, an indirect measure of patient understanding; patient comprehension was not measured.
links.quote: The vast majority were scored as accurate, factually complete, and not perceived as a possible cause of harm for the patients, especially when using prompt 2.

links.comparator_used: Prompt 2, a generic prompt with no audience or reading-level instruction ("What are the most important things I should know from my pathology report?"), versus prompt 1, which named a child audience
links.outcome: Pathologist Likert ratings of accuracy, completeness and potential harm of the simplified explanations
links.effect: Prompt 1 (explain to a child using simple language) was scored less favorably than prompt 2. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Explanations from ChatGPT for prompt 1 were scored less favorably.

design_hint: prompt wording for patient-facing report simplification
